propositions: rebar link command silently records a different edge than requested when cross-subtree blocking links are auto-escalated, leaving the original dependency unrecorded and operator unaware

a ticket can be recorded as blocking its own ancestor or descendant due to comparability being decided from type tier instead of structural parent hierarchy, distorting ready/next-batch work order and claim cascade
resolve_hierarchy_link must replace type-tier comparability with nearest-common-ancestor structural comparability to fix both 1803-df54-18bb-4881 and jira-reb-1582
legacy blocking edges written under the old type-tier rule must be detectable store-wide and repairable in a single pass without breaking the escalation contract callers depend on
ancestor-blocking edges must be structurally unrepresentable by enforcing an invariant on the resolved pair so no path into the resolver can produce them
